description: Ali Asghar Textile Mills Limited was established in 1969 as a textile spinning unit, and in 2011 the management exited spinning and had the memorandum changed to make logistics and warehousing the principal line of business. It now provides warehousing and logistics services to e-commerce businesses — naming Daraz Pakistan, Airlift Technologies and Al-Karam Studios as key clients — and operates a 1,250 kW solar power project, 1 MW of which is supplied to a pharmaceutical company. Its subsidiary Fazal Solar Energy (Pvt.) Limited runs a 1 MW solar generation facility, and the company also holds more than PKR 1 billion of listed equities at the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
headOffice: Ellahi Tower, Plot No. 6, Sector No. 25, Korangi Industrial Area, Karachi, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: aatml.com.pk — Company Profile and Contact pages (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: E-commerce warehousing and logistics

products.name: Solar power generation
